description: Erection of single storey rear extensions, rear and side roof extensions with a juliet balcony to the rear, a new door, window and replacement windows on the side elevation, two rooflights on the front roofslope, and replacement windows to the front and rear elevations.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall be as shown on the submitted drawings.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1773_SE_001_LP_01, 1773_SE_002_SP_02, 1773_SE_100_GND_03, 1773_SE_101_L1_04, 1773_SE_102_L2_05, 1773_SE_103_RFP_06, 1773_SE_110_SEC_07, 1773_SE_111_FE_08, 1773_SE_112_SE_09, 1773_SE_113_RE_10, 1773_SE_200_GND_13, 1773_SE_201_L1_14, 1773_SE_202_L2_15, 1773_SE_203_RFP_16, 1773_SE_211_FE_18, 1773_SE_212_SE_19, 1773_SE_500_V1_23, 1773_SE_501_V2_24, Design and Access Statement and Flood Risk Assessment [received on 12/06/2019] and 1773_SE_213_RE_20 and 1773_SE_210_SEC_17 [received on 25/07/2019]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the extensions hereby approved and no additional doors/windows inserted to the side of the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
